---
title: "CAAS significance: evidence for positions and genes"

date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
author: "PhyloPhere pipeline"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: paged
    fig_width: 10
    fig_height: 5
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"
params:
  meta_caas_input: NULL # Retained for old callers; the report uses canonical scoring tables.
  position_scores_input: NULL
  gene_scores_input: NULL
  gene_metadata_input: NULL
  gene_evidence_input: NULL
  null_universe_input: NULL
  traitname: "trait"
  output_dir: "."
  seed: "1998"
  max_table_rows: 0 # Compatibility only: all positive-score rows are accessible.
---

<!-- 16.CAAS_significance_report.Rmd — Evidence (p, BH q, resolution) of the positive CAAS positions and genes of one trait. -->
<!-- PhyloPhere | subworkflows/CT_META_CAAS/local/ -->
<!-- Author: Miguel Ramon (miguel.ramon@upf.edu) -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, out.width="100%")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2);library(ggrepel);library(scales);library(DT)})

# Shared table helpers (lazy-mounted DataTables). The file sits next to the report in a process work directory
# and in ENRICHMENT/local/src when the report is rendered in place.
.helpers <- c("src/report_presentation.R","../../ENRICHMENT/local/src/report_presentation.R")
.helpers <- .helpers[file.exists(.helpers)]
if(!length(.helpers)) stop("report_presentation.R not found next to the report")
source(.helpers[1])

# Tableau_10 swatch, shared with the other reports of the pipeline.
.tableau10 <- if(requireNamespace("paletteer",quietly=TRUE)) as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10")) else
  c("#4E79A7","#F28E2B","#E15759","#76B7B2","#59A14F","#EDC948","#B07AA1","#FF9DA7","#9C755F","#BAB0AC")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=13)+theme(
  axis.title.y=element_text(margin=ggplot2::margin(l=20,r=20)),axis.title.x=element_text(margin=ggplot2::margin(t=12)),
  plot.title=element_text(face="bold",hjust=0,margin=ggplot2::margin(b=6)),
  plot.subtitle=element_text(colour="grey40",hjust=0,margin=ggplot2::margin(b=10)),
  strip.text=element_text(face="bold"),legend.position="bottom"))

# Evidence classes, from strongest to weakest, and their colours (also used by the tables and the exports).
status_levels <- c("BH","Nominal","Evaluated; not significant","p available; q unavailable","p unavailable")
status_colours <- c("BH"="#E15759","Nominal"="#F28E2B","Evaluated; not significant"="grey65",
  "p available; q unavailable"="#BAB0AC","p unavailable"="grey88")
ranking_labels <- c(global="Global",top="Top",bottom="Bottom")

seed_val <- if(!is.null(params$seed) && nzchar(as.character(params$seed))) as.integer(params$seed) else 1998L
set.seed(seed_val)
plot_cap <- 20000L # points drawn per scatter; every point that is not "Evaluated; not significant" is always drawn

fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x),"NA",format(round(x),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE))
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x),formatC(x,format="g",digits=3),"NA")
file_ok <- function(f) !is.null(f) && length(f)==1L && !is.na(f) && !grepl("^NO_",basename(f)) && file.exists(f) && file.info(f)$size>0
num <- function(d,n) if(n %in% names(d)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[n]])) else rep(NA_real_,nrow(d))
below <- function(p,threshold) ifelse(is.finite(p),p<threshold,NA)
status <- function(p,q) factor(ifelse(!is.finite(p),"p unavailable",
  ifelse(!is.finite(q),"p available; q unavailable",ifelse(q<fdr,"BH",ifelse(p<nominal,"Nominal","Evaluated; not significant")))),
  levels=status_levels)
for(n in c("position_scores_input","gene_scores_input")) if(!file_ok(params[[n]])) stop("Missing canonical scoring input: ",n)
pos <- read_tsv(params$position_scores_input,show_col_types=FALSE)
genes <- read_tsv(params$gene_scores_input,show_col_types=FALSE)
if(!all(c("Gene","Position","side","CAAS_score") %in% names(pos))) stop("Position evidence requires Gene/Position/side/CAAS_score")
if(!all(c("Gene","gene_caas_score","gene_caas_score_top","gene_caas_score_bottom") %in% names(genes))) stop("Missing canonical gene scores for the three rankings")
if(anyDuplicated(genes$Gene)) stop("Duplicate gene evidence keys")
stamp <- params$gene_metadata_input
if(!file_ok(stamp)) stamp <- file.path(dirname(params$gene_scores_input),"gene_evidence_metadata.json")
if(!file_ok(stamp)) stop("Missing gene_evidence_metadata.json")
metadata <- jsonlite::read_json(stamp,simplifyVector=TRUE)
if(!identical(metadata$gene_stat,"max")) stop("Retired gene statistic: regenerate gene evidence with max")
nominal <- as.numeric(metadata$nominal_threshold); fdr <- as.numeric(metadata$fdr_threshold)
stopifnot(length(nominal)==1L,is.finite(nominal),length(fdr)==1L,is.finite(fdr))
for(n in c("CAAS_score","p.emp","p.adj_bh","n_hypotheses")) pos[[n]] <- num(pos,n)
pos$Position <- as.integer(pos$Position)
if(anyDuplicated(pos[c("Gene","Position","side")])) stop("Duplicate canonical position/side keys")
conflict <- pos %>% distinct(Gene,Position,p.emp,p.adj_bh) %>% count(Gene,Position) %>% filter(n>1)
if(nrow(conflict)) stop("Pooled position p/q disagree between sides")
full_gene_family <- lapply(c("global","top","bottom"),function(rk) {
  sf <- if(rk=="global")"" else paste0("_",rk)
  data.frame(ranking=rk,genes_in_source=nrow(genes),genes_with_p=sum(is.finite(num(genes,paste0("caas_p.gen",sf)))),
    genes_with_q=sum(is.finite(num(genes,paste0("caas_p.gen.adj",sf)))))
}) %>% bind_rows()
ge_file <- params$gene_evidence_input
if(!file_ok(ge_file)) ge_file <- file.path(dirname(params$gene_scores_input),"gene_evidence.tsv")
ge <- if(file_ok(ge_file)) read_tsv(ge_file,show_col_types=FALSE) else NULL
if(!is.null(ge)) {
  if(!all(c("gene","ranking","N_valid") %in% names(ge))) stop("Invalid gene calibration schema: requires gene/ranking/N_valid")
  if(anyDuplicated(ge[c("gene","ranking")])) stop("Duplicate gene/ranking calibration records")
}
nu_file <- params$null_universe_input
if(!file_ok(nu_file)) nu_file <- file.path(dirname(params$position_scores_input),"null_universe_summary.tsv")
nu <- if(file_ok(nu_file)) read_tsv(nu_file,show_col_types=FALSE) else NULL
if(!is.null(nu) && !all(c("metric","cycles","value") %in% names(nu))) stop("Invalid null universe summary schema")
metadata_number <- function(n) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metadata[[n]]))
  if(length(x)==1L && is.finite(x)) x else NA_real_
}
metric <- function(n) {
  if(is.null(nu)) return(NA_real_)
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nu$value[nu$metric==n & is.na(nu$cycles)]))
  if(length(x)) x[1] else NA_real_
}
N_position <- metric("N_cycles"); position_family <- metric("universe_size"); N_gene <- metadata_number("N")
positive <- pos %>% filter(is.finite(CAAS_score),CAAS_score>0,side %in% c("top","bottom"))
views_pos <- list()
views_gene <- list()
for(rk in c("global","top","bottom")) {
  sf <- if(rk=="global")"" else paste0("_",rk)
  p <- if(rk=="global") positive else positive %>% filter(side==rk)
  side_labels <- p %>% group_by(Gene,Position) %>% summarise(positive_sides=paste(sort(unique(side)),collapse=","),.groups="drop")
  p <- p %>% arrange(desc(CAAS_score),desc(n_hypotheses),Gene,Position,side) %>% distinct(Gene,Position,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    left_join(side_labels,by=c("Gene","Position")) %>%
    mutate(nominal=below(p.emp,nominal),BH=below(p.adj_bh,fdr),evidence_status=status(p.emp,p.adj_bh)) %>%
    arrange(p.emp,desc(CAAS_score),Gene,Position)
  views_pos[[rk]] <- p
  g <- tibble(Gene=as.character(genes$Gene),score=num(genes,paste0("gene_caas_score",sf)),
    p.gen=num(genes,paste0("caas_p.gen",sf)),p.gen.adj=num(genes,paste0("caas_p.gen.adj",sf))) %>% filter(is.finite(score),score>0)
  pc <- p %>% group_by(Gene) %>% summarise(positive_positions=n(),
    positions_with_p=sum(is.finite(p.emp)),positions_with_q=sum(is.finite(p.adj_bh)),
    positions_nominal=sum(nominal %in% TRUE),positions_BH=sum(BH %in% TRUE),.groups="drop")
  g <- g %>% left_join(pc,by="Gene")
  for(n in c("positive_positions","positions_with_p","positions_with_q","positions_nominal","positions_BH")) g[[n]][is.na(g[[n]])] <- 0L
  g$N_valid <- NA_real_
  if(!is.null(ge)) {
    ix <- match(g$Gene,ge$gene[ge$ranking==rk]);g$N_valid <- num(ge[ge$ranking==rk,,drop=FALSE],"N_valid")[ix]
  }
  g <- g %>% mutate(nominal=below(p.gen,nominal),BH=below(p.gen.adj,fdr),
    carries_position_BH=positions_BH>0,evidence_status=status(p.gen,p.gen.adj),
    min_resolvable_p=ifelse(is.finite(N_valid)&N_valid>0,1/(N_valid+1),NA_real_)) %>% arrange(p.gen,desc(score),Gene)
  views_gene[[rk]] <- g
}
out <- "significance"
dir.create(out,showWarnings=FALSE,recursive=TRUE)
for(rk in names(views_pos)) {
  write_tsv(views_pos[[rk]],file.path(out,paste0("positive_positions_",rk,".tsv")))
  write_tsv(views_gene[[rk]],file.path(out,paste0("positive_genes_",rk,".tsv")))
}
summary_rows <- function(d,rk,unit,pcol,qcol,scol) {
  p <- d[[pcol]];q <- d[[qcol]]
  tibble(ranking=rk,unit=unit,positive_rows=nrow(d),p_available=sum(is.finite(p)),q_available=sum(is.finite(q)),
    positive_without_p=sum(!is.finite(p)),nominal=sum(below(p,nominal) %in% TRUE),BH=sum(below(q,fdr) %in% TRUE),
    genes_carrying_position_BH=if(unit=="genes")sum(d$carries_position_BH) else n_distinct(d$Gene[below(q,fdr) %in% TRUE]),
    score_median=if(nrow(d))median(d[[scol]]) else NA_real_)
}
summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(views_pos),function(rk) bind_rows(
  summary_rows(views_pos[[rk]],rk,"positions","p.emp","p.adj_bh","CAAS_score"),
  summary_rows(views_gene[[rk]],rk,"genes","p.gen","p.gen.adj","score"))))
write_tsv(summary,file.path(out,"positive_evidence_summary.tsv"))
write_tsv(full_gene_family,file.path(out,"original_gene_family_coverage.tsv"))
resolution <- tibble(unit=c("Positions (family pooled over sides)","Genes (per ranking)"),
  N_roster=c(N_position,N_gene),
  roster_min_p=ifelse(is.finite(c(N_position,N_gene)),1/(c(N_position,N_gene)+1),NA_real_),
  original_family_size=c(position_family,metadata_number("genes")))
write_tsv(resolution,file.path(out,"null_resolution.tsv"))
# Family sizes are counts; integers keep them undecorated in the table.
resolution_view <- resolution %>% mutate(across(c(N_roster,original_family_size),~suppressWarnings(as.integer(round(.x)))))
# Compatibility export now contains canonical, globally unique positive positions.
write_tsv(views_pos$global,file.path(out,"meta_caas_significance.tsv"))

# ── Plot helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Draws every row that is not "Evaluated; not significant" and a random subsample of those, so the figure stays light.
thin <- function(d) {
  bulk <- d$evidence_status=="Evaluated; not significant"
  if(sum(bulk)<=plot_cap) return(d)
  bind_rows(d[!bulk,,drop=FALSE],d[bulk,,drop=FALSE][sample.int(sum(bulk),plot_cap),,drop=FALSE])
}
evidence_scatter <- function(d,score,p,label,floor_p,title) {
  d <- d[is.finite(d[[p]]) & is.finite(d[[score]]),,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(d)) {cat("_No row of this view has an available p; the scatter is omitted._\n\n");return(invisible(NULL))}
  d$y <- -log10(pmax(d[[p]],1e-300)); d$x <- d[[score]]
  # Hits tie at the resolution floor, so ties are ordered by score; the few labels sit in the headroom above the points.
  hits <- d %>% filter(evidence_status=="BH") %>% arrange(desc(y),desc(x)) %>% head(8)
  g <- ggplot(thin(d),aes(x,y,colour=evidence_status))+
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(nominal),linetype="dashed",colour="grey45")+
    geom_point(alpha=.55,size=1.5)+
    scale_colour_manual(values=status_colours,drop=FALSE,name=NULL)+
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.22)))+
    labs(title=title,subtitle=sprintf("Dashed line: nominal threshold p = %g. Dotted line: resolution floor 1/(N+1) of the null roster.",nominal),
         x="CAAS score",y=expression(-log[10]~p))+guides(colour=guide_legend(override.aes=list(alpha=1,size=3)))
  if(is.finite(floor_p)) g <- g+geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(floor_p),linetype="dotted",colour="grey25")
  if(nrow(hits)) g <- g+geom_text_repel(data=hits,aes(label=.data[[label]]),size=3,colour="grey20",max.overlaps=Inf,min.segment.length=0,
    nudge_y=.12*diff(range(d$y)),direction="x",segment.colour="grey60",seed=seed_val)
  print(g)
}
evidence_histograms <- function(d,score,p,q,title) {
  dd <- bind_rows(tibble(variable="Score",value=d[[score]]),tibble(variable="p",value=d[[p]]),tibble(variable="q (BH)",value=d[[q]])) %>%
    filter(is.finite(value)) %>% mutate(variable=factor(variable,c("Score","p","q (BH)")))
  if(!nrow(dd)) {cat("_Distributions are not available._\n\n");return(invisible(NULL))}
  print(ggplot(dd,aes(value,fill=variable))+geom_histogram(bins=35,colour="white",show.legend=FALSE)+
    facet_wrap(~variable,scales="free")+scale_fill_manual(values=c(Score=.tableau10[1],p=.tableau10[2],"q (BH)"=.tableau10[4]))+
    labs(title=title,x=NULL,y="Rows of this view"))
}
kpi <- function(value,label,sub="",class="") sprintf('<div class="kpi %s"><div class="v">%s</div><div class="l">%s</div><div class="s">%s</div></div>',class,value,label,sub)
```

$(document).on('shown.bs.tab shown.bs.collapse', function () {
  if ($.fn.dataTable) $.fn.dataTable.tables({visible: true, api: true}).columns.adjust();
});

# Overview

```{r overview, results='asis'}
sp <- function(rk,u) summary[summary$ranking==rk & summary$unit==u,,drop=FALSE]
cat('<div class="kpi-row">',
  kpi(fmt_int(sp("global","positions")$positive_rows),"positive positions","score > 0, one row per (Gene, Position)"),
  kpi(fmt_int(sp("global","positions")$BH),sprintf("positions with BH q < %g",fdr),sprintf("%s nominal at p < %g",fmt_int(sp("global","positions")$nominal),nominal),"bh"),
  kpi(fmt_int(sp("global","positions")$genes_carrying_position_BH),"genes carrying a BH position","global ranking","bh"),
  kpi(fmt_int(sp("global","genes")$positive_rows),"positive genes","gene score > 0","gene"),
  kpi(fmt_int(sp("global","genes")$BH),sprintf("genes with BH q < %g",fdr),sprintf("%s nominal at p < %g",fmt_int(sp("global","genes")$nominal),nominal),"bh"),
  '</div>\n\n',sep="\n")
cat(sprintf("Calls follow the thresholds saved with the evidence: nominal p < %g and BH q < %g. Counts above refer to the Global view; Top and Bottom are in the tabs below.\n\n",nominal,fdr))
```

The report shows only positions and genes whose **observed score is greater than 0 in the view concerned**. Global has one row per biological position `(Gene, Position)` with its maximum score over sides; Top and Bottom use the score of their own side. Coordinates are those of the trimmed alignment, zero-based, so position 0 is valid.

<div class="note">
**How to read the evidence.**

- Position p-values are pooled over sides and shown with their original BH q. Top and Bottom are therefore not two new families of tests.
- Genes have their own p and BH q for each ranking.
- Keeping rows with a positive score only changes the presentation. p, q and the BH families are not recomputed, and a missing p is reported as unavailable, never as not significant.
- A gene with BH significance and a gene that carries a BH-significant position are different statistical results; their counts are given separately.
</div>

## Evidence classes

```{r classes, results='asis', fig.height=4}
cls <- bind_rows(lapply(names(views_pos),function(rk) bind_rows(
  count(views_pos[[rk]],evidence_status,.drop=FALSE) %>% mutate(unit="Positions",ranking=rk),
  count(views_gene[[rk]],evidence_status,.drop=FALSE) %>% mutate(unit="Genes",ranking=rk)))) %>%
  mutate(ranking=factor(ranking_labels[ranking],ranking_labels),unit=factor(unit,c("Positions","Genes")),
         evidence_status=factor(evidence_status,status_levels))
tot <- cls %>% group_by(unit,ranking) %>% summarise(total=sum(n),.groups="drop")
lab <- cls %>% left_join(tot,by=c("unit","ranking")) %>% filter(n>0,n/total>=.06)
print(ggplot(cls,aes(ranking,n,fill=evidence_status))+geom_col(position="fill",width=.7)+
  geom_text(data=lab,aes(label=fmt_int(n)),position=position_fill(vjust=.5),size=3.4,colour="white")+
  coord_flip()+facet_wrap(~unit,ncol=1)+scale_y_continuous(labels=percent)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=status_colours,drop=FALSE,name=NULL)+
  labs(title="Evidence class of the positive rows",subtitle="Share of each view; labels show counts for segments of at least 6%",x=NULL,y=NULL))
```

# Coverage, denominators and resolution

```{r coverage, results='asis'}
cat("**Positive rows per view, with p and q availability and calls.**\n\n")
report_emit(report_table(summary))
cat("**Original gene families, before the score filter.** Counts with p or q include genes of score zero.\n\n")
report_emit(report_table(full_gene_family))
cat("**Resolution of the null.** `roster_min_p` is the smallest p the roster can express, 1/(N+1), if every cycle were valid.\n\n")
report_emit(report_table(resolution_view,sci_cols="roster_min_p"))
cat("Summary denominators are the positive rows of each view. The original positional family also contains null positions that were never detected in the observed data. `N_valid` and the actual per-gene resolution come from `gene_evidence.tsv`; the roster floor assumes all cycles valid. An undocumented resolution stays NA and is never inferred from the smallest observed p.\n\n")
```

# Positions {.tabset}

```{r positions, results='asis'}
for(rk in names(views_pos)) {
  cat("\n## ",ranking_labels[[rk]],"\n\n",sep="")
  d <- views_pos[[rk]]
  cat(sprintf("%s positive positions: %s with p and %s with q available; %s nominal, %s BH in %s genes.\n\n",
    fmt_int(nrow(d)),fmt_int(sum(is.finite(d$p.emp))),fmt_int(sum(is.finite(d$p.adj_bh))),fmt_int(sum(d$nominal %in% TRUE)),
    fmt_int(sum(d$BH %in% TRUE)),fmt_int(n_distinct(d$Gene[d$BH %in% TRUE]))))
  evidence_scatter(transform(d,label=paste0(Gene,":",Position)),"CAAS_score","p.emp","label",
    if(is.finite(N_position)) 1/(N_position+1) else NA_real_,paste("Positions,",tolower(ranking_labels[[rk]]),"view"))
  cat("\n\n")
  evidence_histograms(d,"CAAS_score","p.emp","p.adj_bh",paste("Positions,",tolower(ranking_labels[[rk]]),"view"))
  cat("\n\n")
  front <- c("Gene","Position","side","positive_sides","CAAS_score","p.emp","p.adj_bh","evidence_status","nominal","BH")
  report_emit(report_table(d %>% mutate(evidence_status=as.character(evidence_status)) %>% relocate(any_of(front)),
    sci_cols=intersect(c("p.emp","p.adj_bh"),names(d))))
}
```

# Genes {.tabset}

```{r genes, results='asis'}
for(rk in names(views_gene)) {
  cat("\n## ",ranking_labels[[rk]],"\n\n",sep="")
  d <- views_gene[[rk]]
  cat(sprintf("%s positive genes: %s BH and %s carrying positions that are BH in this same view.\n\n",
    fmt_int(nrow(d)),fmt_int(sum(d$BH %in% TRUE)),fmt_int(sum(d$carries_position_BH))))
  evidence_scatter(d,"score","p.gen","Gene",if(is.finite(N_gene)) 1/(N_gene+1) else NA_real_,paste("Genes,",tolower(ranking_labels[[rk]]),"ranking"))
  cat("\n\n")
  top_carriers <- d %>% filter(positions_BH>0) %>% arrange(desc(positions_BH),desc(score),Gene) %>% head(20) %>%
    mutate(Gene=factor(Gene,rev(Gene)))
  if(nrow(top_carriers)) {
    print(ggplot(top_carriers,aes(positions_BH,Gene,fill=evidence_status))+geom_col(width=.7)+
      scale_fill_manual(values=status_colours,drop=TRUE,name="Gene-level evidence")+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=function(x) {b <- pretty(x); b[b==round(b)]},expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.05)))+
      labs(title=paste("Genes carrying the most BH positions,",tolower(ranking_labels[[rk]]),"view"),
           subtitle="Bar colour is the evidence class of the gene itself, which is a separate test",x="Positions with BH q below threshold",y=NULL))
    cat("\n\n")
  } else cat("_No gene of this view carries a BH-significant position._\n\n")
  evidence_histograms(d,"score","p.gen","p.gen.adj",paste("Genes,",tolower(ranking_labels[[rk]]),"ranking"))
  cat("\n\n")
  front <- c("Gene","score","p.gen","p.gen.adj","evidence_status","nominal","BH","carries_position_BH","positive_positions","positions_BH","positions_nominal","N_valid","min_resolvable_p")
  report_emit(report_table(d %>% mutate(evidence_status=as.character(evidence_status)) %>% relocate(any_of(front)),
    sci_cols=intersect(c("p.gen","p.gen.adj","min_resolvable_p"),names(d))))
}
```

# Complete tables

The paginated tables hold every positive row and can be searched, sorted and exported. The complete numeric TSV files are published under `meta_caas/significance/`:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `positive_positions_{global,top,bottom}.tsv` | positive positions with p, q, calls and evidence class |
| `positive_genes_{global,top,bottom}.tsv` | positive genes with p, q, position counts and resolution |
| `positive_evidence_summary.tsv` | counts shown in the coverage table |
| `original_gene_family_coverage.tsv` | gene families before the score filter |
| `null_resolution.tsv` | roster size and smallest expressible p |
| `meta_caas_significance.tsv` | globally unique positive positions, for compatibility |
